rows.name: OBSERVATION: gas per page (first epoch, EOA payees) on real Besu EVM
rows.detail: pages (first epoch, EOA payees, in the order paid): 1 payee=243111 gas (the first page also pays the one-time zero->nonzero writes of the open distribution record), then 2 payees=243345 gas three times. open=383675, close=342236. NOTE: the page(2)-page(1) difference (234) is NOT a marginal cost (the first page has one-time writes); the marginal gas per payee is measured on the test-only net B with many payees (stage 2c).
